title: Hypnogogic experiences
content: I woke up last night from an urban exploration dream, but didn't open my eyes. I kept my eyes closed and continued seeing the world unfolding. It was like Deep Dream or how AI draws artwork, but not colorful. I would see one element forming, and focus on it, and keep seeing permutations of that. For example, I'd look at a ceiling vent, and see many different ones forming all around it, with variations of the pattern, like different dimensions. Then move my focus to another element, like a door, and see that one forming more of itself. They would split and drift apart. Stories would start to form as people began to appear and do things. It was an interesting experience of essentially being conscious will seeing a dream forming.
